notes.title: A Letter from the Developers
notes.content:
A Letter from the Developers
Dear Traveler,

Since its launch in September 2023, Dragonheir has received support and love from 10 million Travelers worldwide. Your perseverance and feedback give us the confidence and motivation to make this game the best it can be.
We deeply understand that many Travelers have been dissatisfied with Dragonheir's lack of new content since December. I'd like to take this opportunity to communicate with all Travelers about what has happened with Dragonheir over the past year and a half, and to talk about our plans moving forward.

I. Changes
From late 2023 to early 2024, while we were still basking in the joy of Dragonheir's successful launch, various unexpected changes began to occur both within and outside our team, causing the development of new content to stagnate for nearly a year. After numerous efforts, it wasn't until the end of 2024 that Dragonheir was finally able to reconnect with players in most regions around the world.

II. Issues and Adjustments
The migration was a significant loss for both the project team and the players, but it also gave us an opportunity to examine ourselves.
While migrating, we have also begun reflecting on and revising Dragonheir. We believe that for Dragonheir to perform better, we need to address the following issues:
1. Too Expensive: The $5 per summon price and the gacha design focused on a general pool with all heroes mixed together were too costly for most players. It was too expensive to obtain the heroes a player wanted, and even after four seasons, many players still couldn't assemble mainstream hero lineups to experience the joy of strategic gameplay.
2. High Learning Curve for Team Strategies: In-game, we lacked guidance for hero team composition, requiring players to invest enormous effort into researching hero skills, equipment, and team synergies. For players with fewer Legendary heroes, finding effective team strategies was even more difficult.
3. Lack of Diverse Gameplay: We introduced numerous challenge stages centered around team strategies. However, stages alone don't create a complete gaming experience. The game's modes still need adjustment and expansions.

Therefore, since October 2024, we have been working to adjust the game's content, hoping to welcome all players back with an improved experience. Our changes include:
• Significant Price Reductions: We hope that by lowering the cost of each summon, adding targeted banners, and setting more reasonable pity systems, most players will be able to assemble strategically viable teams.
• Streamlined Progression: We want players to spend less time leveling up individual heroes and more time focusing on the core gameplay to have fun: selecting suitable heroes and using effective strategies to overcome stronger opponents. As a result, we've completely abandoned individual hero levels. All heroes now share a level, making them as close to "ready to use upon summoning" as possible.
• Combat System Overhaul: With reduced prices and streamlined progression focusing players on team strategy enjoyment, we needed more accessible strategic gameplay that beginners could easily grasp and gradually master. To achieve this, we've replaced our previous Elemental Affinity-based team building guide with "comps," each with different effects. Through these strategies, we hope players will gradually understand each hero's abilities and discover unique approaches to tackle different bosses.
• Redesigned Season Gameplay: To address the "combat needs to be fun" issue, we focused on "having fun content." As a seasonal game, the purpose of seasons shouldn't just be a new round of competition. We want each season to focus players on different core gameplay elements, so we've planned various central mechanics, such as Alliance PvP and Alliance Boss modes, as well as solo roguelike gameplay. We hope to continuously bring players new experiences.
These features were first launched in the mainland China version and have proven effective. Now we finally have the confidence to synchronize these adjustments with the global version.

III. Rebirth: Global Version Challenges and Plans
The reason we launched in mainland China first was because it was a completely new region, allowing us to adjust the game to its optimal state without interference from existing online data. Now, as we return to the global version, any modifications directly affect tens of thousands of online players, so we must proceed with caution.

After careful consideration, we plan to restart Dragonheir's global version content updates and promotion strategy in the following ways:
1. Season Restart with Synchronized Content: We want all players to experience the proven content. Therefore, in the global version, we will restart seasons and updates, releasing new content according to the seasonal schedule and merging it with the global version. All players will start from Season 1, but user data will be retained: Due to significant adjustments to hero abilities and seasonal gameplay, after the new version update, all players will need to begin from the brand new Season 1.
2. All players will start from Season 1, but user data will be retained: Due to significant adjustments to hero abilities and seasonal gameplay, after the new version update, all players will need to begin from the brand new Season 1. However, players will retain their heroes, Artifacts, Dragon Crystals, Wyrmarrows, dice, and Skill Scrolls. Your assets will not be lost, so please don't worry.
3. Account valuation for veteran players with exclusive benefits: In addition to retaining all user data, before the official restart, we will launch an account valuation event for veteran players, returning your previous investments in the form of special rewards in the new version. Through this approach, we hope to express our sincere gratitude to the Travelers who have continuously supported us by providing attractive rewards, and we encourage you to spread the word, to reunite with your former battle mates to once again venture across the continent of Adenthia. (Please follow upcoming community content for detailed rules)
4. Complete global launch: When the new version goes live, Dragonheir will also relaunch in North America and several other affected regions. We are delighted to once again provide complete service to Travelers across all global regions.

Detailed update plans and event information will be gradually released through Discord and Facebook communities in the future. Travelers, please stay tuned.
For all players who have persevered and accompanied Dragonheir until today, our hearts are filled with gratitude. We also solemnly promise to continue delivering quality updates for the global version, bringing Travelers more and better gameplay experiences.
To express our gratitude, we're offering a gift code containing 5 Heliolite Dice, 10 Starlight Stone Dice, and 1,000,000 Gold, which you can redeem by entering the game now:【BRANDNEWDH】(Valid from April 28 to May 31.)

We hope you continue to follow Dragonheir and the community before the season restart. We also welcome your feedback in the community. Together, let us witness the rebirth of a better Dragonheir.

notes.title: Development Future Roadmap (Episode 1)
notes.content:
Dear Travelers,
Thank you all for supporting us along the journey in Dragonheir: Silent Gods. We are delighted to witness your adventures and have received numerous recognitions and suggestions.
One of the issues you are most concerned about has always been the future game content. This has been our primary focus. In the subsequent game versions, we will bring you new progression modes, gameplay content, and improvements to reduce the grind. We hope to share our update plans with you and hope you can take some time to read this article:

New Progression Modes
1. [Easier EXP Gains]
To reduce the time spent on less interesting grinding gameplay, we plan to introduce the Level Resonance feature, which will directly boost your entire team's level. Once this feature is activated, the Breakthrough system will also be adjusted accordingly, significantly speeding up your leveling experience and hero progression. After the first month of a new season, you will no longer need to grind EXP Dungeons.

2. [Richer Progression Experience]
We hope players can enjoy a more intuitive, positive gaming experience during the mid-to-late season progression:
We will introduce a Hero Talent system, providing heroes with multi-branch talent trees. By choosing different talent paths for your heroes, they can specialize in certain areas, bringing you more diverse battle strategies and deeper progression experiences. The corresponding Elemental Talent Dungeon will also be launched along with this system.
To make the roles of various heroes more distinct, we are also working on an Equipment Attribute Enhancement feature. This will offer you more freedom when you are configuring lineups.
Additionally, we plan to introduce an Attribute Transfer feature, allowing equipment attributes to be directly transferred to another piece of new equipment, aiming to reduce repetitive grinding content.

3. Progression Recycling
We noticed that many players experienced a progression gap due to resource resets during season transitions. To improve the cross-season progression experience, we will retain certain results that are hard to achieve in the current season through the Progression Recycling system.

New Gameplay Content
1. [Roguelike Gameplay]
To meet your need for deeper strategic gameplay, we plan to introduce tiered roguelike content. In this mode, you will gradually build your team through random events and enjoy the fun of overcoming stages with different team lineups.

2. [New Arena: The Emerald Court]
The Emerald Court emphasizes strategic fun with fair competition. In this mode, all players will choose from heroes, equipment, and artifacts with the same attributes. You will build your very own PvP team and enjoy deeper strategic experiences by adjusting skill release timings before battles.

A More Friendly Grinding Experience
1. [Auto Tower Climbing]
The Fey Meander and the Pillar of Trial are two major challenges in each season that require you to invest a lot of time to conquer. We plan to introduce an Auto Tower Climb feature to alleviate the fatigue from such a grinding experience.

2. [Other Optimizations]
Besides the above, we will also introduce features like Equip All for quick hero equipment setup, Auto Pathing, Camp Dispatch, Temporary Mounts, and other optimization features to reduce the grind. We will also optimize multiplayer real-time non-auto battle gameplay and adjust various stages and boss mechanics to bring you a more relaxed and fun gaming experience.

Spoiler
Apart from the Lamar Volcano sandbox, which is to be introduced during the Otherworld Exploration phase of Season 4, future storylines and sandboxes are also in the works. The currently available sandboxes, storylines, and NPC interactions will also be optimized to provide a more immersive experience.

notes.title: Dragonheir: Silent Gods - Season 2 Q&A
notes.content:
Dear Adenthia Travelers:
　　Greetings! The Chaos Clepsydra is about to be inverted, and Season 1 of Dragonheir: Silent Gods is coming to an end. Over the Season, we have watched as you travelers met new Hero companions and faced challenges with fellow Alliance members. It brings us great pleasure to see your passion and enjoyment of the game and its various gameplay modes.
　　As we have promised, we will be expanding upon the story and various gameplay content, as well as making adjustments to the game according to your feedback.
　　Near the end of Season 1, we would like to answer some of the questions you have been asking us about the new Season.

[Story]
Q1: Can I still experience the Main Quests and Side Quests in Season 2, if I haven't completed them in Season 1?
A1: We will be introducing a brand-new quest system in Season 2, but the one-time quests available in Season 1 will no longer be available once the Season is over, so be sure to experience them before they're gone for good!
Q2: Will the story receive updates in Season 2?
A2: Of course! Season 2 will feature a whole new Main Quest, new Side Quests, and Exploration content. We will also be looking at revamping some gameplay mechanics of the old map to improve adventurers' early-game experience.

[Seasonal Reset]
Q1: Which items will be kept in Season 2?
A1: In the game, you can view the reservation rules for items of each category. We recommend adventurers check out Clepsydra Trail for a detailed description of how various items will be reset and which items will be kept.
Q2: Can I reset Heroes' Skill Levels in the new Season?
A2: As detailed in the rules in Clepsydra Trail, during the first 144 hours in each season, you can reset your heroes' level and have your invested resources refunded. However, Heroes' skill levels cannot be reset.
Q3: After the Season resets, are we going to have to experience another long grind to level up?
A3: As we have mentioned, we want to use Seasons to highlight the Card RPG experience, to remove the tiresome dungeon grinds with more achievable goals, as well as to emphasize three aspects of the gameplay experience: The early-game grinds, quick character building, and the strategic tackling of challenges. We will continue to observe and try to strike a fun balance among these three aspects.
Q4: Will Alliances stay in the new Season?
A4: Existing Alliances will be disbanded in the new season, and adventurers must create a new Alliance and start from scratch in the new season.

[Updates and Improvements]
Q1: Will there be new Heroes in Season 2?
A1: Season 2 will introduce 3 new playstyles, namely, Burn, Ice Blast, and Thunderbolt, and 30 new Heroes in total. We hope this provides a richer experience as you come up with comps and strategies against various opponents.
Q2: Having to build Heroes from scratch every Season takes a lot of time. Will adjustments be made to the repetitive content?
A2: We are working on various solutions to make the experience less repetitive, such as reducing the time needed to engage in repeating content to make sure you have enough time to experience other fun parts of the game.

[Other Updates]
Apart from the aforementioned content, we will also be making adjustments and improvements in other aspects of the game. Here are some examples:
● Server Invitation
- In season 1, the feature to invite friends into the same server was only available to Alliances, but now that we have made it easier for new players to catch up on the in-game progress, this feature will become available to individual players as well.
- New players cannot directly access season 2 because they are too far behind on in-game progress than the veteran players. They must at least run through some in-game content before they can join in on the latest fun.
● Other Improvements
- Leader Impeachment
Once the Leader has been offline for 7 days, the Vice Leader can start an impeachment to ensure the benefit of all the Alliance members.
- Alliance Chat
Chat messages from other Alliance members will be retained even when you are offline.
● Benefits
- Season 1 Settlement Hero Pool
We will be opening a Settlement Hero Pool: Season Forthfaring Summons. The number of summons available in this Pool will be decided by Season 1 settlements. Every 10 summons guarantees at least 1 Legendary Hero. In addition, this pool has a high chance of turning up new Season 2 Heroes.
- Season 2 Exclusive Hero Pool
At the same time, two weeks before the new Season begins, another Hero Pool that features only new Season 2 Heroes will be opened. In this Pool, you can get all new Season 2 Heroes, including the new SPs [Exclusive Artifact Heroes] Beldelle, Perkunte, and Aschetius.

　　Thank you all for supporting Dragonheir: Silent Gods. We would greatly appreciate it if you would continue to play in the upcoming Season and keep giving us feedback and suggestions. We will continue to observe, listen, and improve, as you embark on exciting adventures in the new Season.
　　We look forward to seeing you in [Fall of Increscent] and witnessing the continuation of your epic in Adenthia!

[olist]
 Golden Wing Points Match and Sparkle Tournament are both available once per week, and they take turns to become available. Their participation requirements are the same: your Alliance must have at least 15 active members over the past three days.
 During Alliance Battle, new members will not be able to participate in this event. For those who have left their Alliance, the points they earned with their previous Alliance will stay with their previous Alliance, but they won't be eligible to receive follow-up rewards.
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/ae43b1558f246a617c1c5bb295717ba5d622f4f0.png

Answer The Call Of Your Alliance To Earn Challenge Rewards!
After this update, you can directly play the temporal vortex challenge in the Alliance Rally menu, and more difficulty levels will be available for you to choose from. As you can expect, the rewards associated with each difficulty may vary. Additionally, we have made some adjustments to how points are tallied and how the reward mechanic works.
● Previously, this game mode keeps track of the damage you have dealt, but now it keeps track of the points you have earned and offers Alliance rewards based on those points.
● Players will receive Alliance Challenge points based on the amount of damage dealt to the boss. When an Alliance has enough points, it will unlock rewards for everyone.
*The points and reward progress are refreshed daily. Unclaimed rewards will be mailed to players instead.
*Alliance members who have not participated in the event on a day will not be eligible to receive the rewards that day.
*By fighting a boss on a higher difficulty, you will earn more points. On the same difficulty, you earn more points if you deal more damage.

Team Arena Now Available; Gameplay Just Got More Strategic
After this update, the Grand Arena will introduce a 3v3 team-based mode called Team Arena.
Many Travelers thought the gameplay was too limited in the single-team Competitive Mode, and to ensure the power of their lineups, players would often have to give up on their chance to experiment with more interesting builds. However, that will change with this new mode where the increased number of teams will surely make the game more unpredictable and exciting. It is time to get creative!
● Format: In this mode, the participants must create three teams of 5 and take turns to fight.
● Participation Cost: Team Invitations (which is replenished by 1 every 2 hours, up to 10).
● Gameplay Rules: In this mode, players must set up their own defensive lineup and fend off other players or take the fight to them instead.
*Team Arena becomes available on the 22nd day of a season.
*What sets this apart from the Grand Gladiator Arena is that players must set up 3 teams for offense or defense. In a game, the result of each battle will affect your points and rewards. Whether you are on the offensive or defensive, upon victory, you'll get to raise your ranking and earn additional rewards.
*In Team Arena, the effect of Ultimate Energy Reduction is reduced to 50%. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/7b55c421e0eb6b2f4c158f487f6ba6c1f56f5eb2.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/cf606cc9b04e8eb5b3cca038870a0a1f4b6f4185.png

Optimized Competitive Mode For Better Combat Experience
In this update, we have optimized the Grand Arena in many ways based on the feedback from our players.
● Hero Resonance: In the Grand Arena, the level of all your Heroes will be synced to match that of your highest-level Hero. This way, even your underdeveloped Heroes can become as powerful as they would be at high levels in this mode, which means it is more flexible for you to build your lineup.
● Exclusive Equipment Plan: In the Grand Arena, participants can set a separate Equipment Plan for this mode for all their Heroes so they won't have to keep switching equipment when accessing a different mode.
*After this update, when you play Competitive Mode for the first time, you will still have to configure your equipment again.
*The Equipment Plan of each Hero will be available either in Adventure Mode or Competitive Mode.
*You cannot upgrade or improve your Heroes in Competitive Mode.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/cf606cc9b04e8eb5b3cca038870a0a1f4b6f4185.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/f21e47433c4174eabcc726dedcb520a3d05e3fe5.png

Lineup Feature Now Available; Improved Hero Skill AI
We have always been thinking about how to improve the combat experience for our players, and in this update, we will add some new features for that and make the in-game combat more convenient and satisfying.
● The Lineup Feature: Now, you can edit and save your lineup before you start playing. This feature is available in every dungeon.
*Currently, you can save up to 6 lineups.
● Customize The Timing For Hero Skills: Now, when Auto-combat is enabled, you can preset the timing of ultimate skills for your active Heroes.
*This feature is unavailable in all types of game modes in the Grand Gladiator Arena and some battles in the Sparkle Tournament (i.e. the Sharpteeth Gate, Heatwave Outpost, and the Eternal Three Ears).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/224b74bd354dd8d9a030525c2b264dddcd93cf9e.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/97a78d2c173f1a405c3e6827f9bc50f0fcfb3579.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/cda2e5cf29716997d010deb54641984e6274a2b2.png


More New Content And Optimizations
Poetry Collect and Exchange
After this update, there will be a Poetry Collect and Exchange Shop. By playing Reunion dungeons, you can get Pages of Legendary Poems and exchange them for various rewards.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/2e867d8757cc73945f3a28ec0e7b80682299f4f4.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/09da40a54142834ad7ef21c90037c1b4fee184c8.png

Avatar Frames
In this update, we added more Avatar Frames for our Travelers to obtain and use.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/d40e251fe16cf73f3f9988de03fd58b2953fb36c.png

Combat Video Replay & Clear
In this update, we added the Combat Video feature. You can replay combat videos on the lineup recommendation page and the result page of Grand Gladiator Arena and Team Arena. This allows you to reminisce the highlight moments of a previous battle and learn from experience.
*In Competitive Mode, you can only replay the combat videos where you are the defender.
*You can go to Settings -> Battle to clear the download cache of your combat videos.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/1588dbab61fa7e4c525c7f4b95c074e4ce348f32.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/d785a4e687161f1f8c41dcd29fc6e79e9ea733f9.png

Other Updates
[olist]
 Added five languages, including Spanish, Portuguese, Thai, Indonesian, and Arabic.
 Optimized some interactive UI designs to better match the overall style and improve the playing experience.
 Optimized the reverberation SFX of some indoor scenes and the SFX of some menus.
 Optimized the graphics of some scenes.
 Optimized the visuals and quest logic of some events.
 Other in-game features and accessibility adjustments.
[/olist]

notes.title: A Letter From Dragonheir: Silent Gods Developer — Global Launch Preview
notes.content:
To Adenthia's pioneering Adventurers:

Greetings, one and all! As Dragonheir: Silent Gods S0 draws to a close, we have been grateful for your company for over two months now! Seeing so many Adventurers enthusiastically enjoying the immersion of our vibrant world and rich stories in tandem with highly strategic battles and versatile character line-ups has been a real pleasure for all of us here!
So many players have spoken fondly of their experience of the story and urged us to release story updates. Rest assured! This is only the beginning! Your adventures in Adenthia will brim with even more ambitious stories, with even more engaging, diverse content. We have been working tirelessly to bring even more new content that will be simultaneously launched with the Global Launch on September 19th!
Equally, we take player feedback and suggestions seriously! We aim to address any problems you encountered with our many improvements and adjustments newly implemented in the Global Launch. For any questions you may have about this new version, hopefully the following will clarify everything:
[Map & Story]
Q1: Will there be any [New Maps] added to the Global Launch?
A1: The brand new Underground Sandbox will be coming to the Global Launch soon. It will feature new challenges of both main quests and local quests, ensuring players will have plenty of playable content by Mid-Season.
Q2: Will the [Story] be updated in the Global Launch?
A2: To ensure players have a more immersive, rewarding and complete experience, we have added a substantial amount to the storyline of the Plains and Underground (new map!) in the Global Launch.

[New Content & Adjustments]
Q1: When will the population [Lizardfolk] be available in the Player Character customization?
A1: The moment you have all been waiting for, Adventurers! The new customizable lizardfolk will be launched simultaneously with the Global Launch, allowing you to pick this population for your newest playthrough!
Q2: Will any [New Heroes] be added to the Global Launch?
A2: Over 60 new heroes will be added to the Global Launch! Moreover, we will continue to update frequently in later Seasons to ensure players will always have new builds to explore.
Q3: Will [Elemental Affinity] in the Global Launch be different than that in the previous game version? How will it be changed?
A3: Seasons are a key feature of our game. Each Season sees a rotation shift in Elemental Affinity and its rules, guaranteeing a different experience at all gameplay stages. In S1, [Fire & Poison], [Radiance & Lightning], and [Necrosis & Ice] will form new pairings.
Q4: Some heroes don't have suitable [Artifacts], while some powerful artifacts cannot be assigned to multiple heroes at once.
A4: We intended the artifact system to allow players to develop their heroes with greater flexibility and to choose their favored progression path. Therefore, we will continue introducing a wider range of artifacts for you to choose from. After the Global Launch is launched, over 20 new artifacts will be introduced. We'll also introduce more ways to acquire artifacts, helping Adventurers progress more quickly.
Q5: There are not enough [Rewards] from quests and events, and some rewards cannot be obtained by average players in a reasonable amount of time.
A5: We heard your feedback! In the Global Launch, we will be improving reward content and reducing the acquisition threshold for some rewards, allowing players a smoother development path.
Q6: When I encounter [Difficulties] in-game, I often need to spend half the day working it out. Is there any better way to seek help?
A6: Once the Global Launch is live, we will launch a built-in AI Q&A Wizard to answer all sorts of everyday questions in-game, helping players jump into the game in no time!
Q7: There are too many heroes! Which heroes do you [Recommend for Development] early on? Who is the best choice for each different Dungeon?
A7: Having more heroes to choose from can make strategic team building more fun, but it inevitably increases the training costs for new players. To address this issue, we will be updating the Lineup Tips feature in the Global Launch. Players will be able to rate each card and provide their own lineup recommendations for different Dungeons. By promoting communication and exchanges among players, everyone's understanding of the game will be improved overall.

[Dungeons]
Q1: Will there be any new [EXP Dungeon] besides Goblin Lair?
A1: There'll be a new EXP Dungeon in the Underground Sandbox giving players the room to experiment with AOE lineups and development rate. The Dungeon will feature a set number of monster waves, with rewards being granted according to the number of waves cleared. Adventurers that clear every wave will obtain all the rewards!
Q2: The [Dungeon Reward] items are limited, and some Dungeons are not challenging enough in the late game.
A2: In the Global Launch, new content will be added to the Pillar of Trial and the Fey Meander, posing players with even more of a challenge. We have also added a host of new rewards: limited legendary artifacts, limited epic heroes, and a number of entirely exclusive rewards unobtainable through purchases! Even more beneficial, this Dungeon type will encourage players to experiment with and devise even better strategies for clearing Dungeons.
Q3: Will there be any other [New Dungeon] designs for the game?
A3: Besides the regular Dungeons, the new Season Dungeon will be introduced with the Global Launch. Players will be given advance notice before this Dungeon opens. We recommend that players prepare even more lineups to face the complex challenges that await! Season Events will be launched Mid-Season, where you can acquire limited legendary heroes and artifacts! These rewards are exclusive to Season Dungeon and are not available through summons, purchase, or any other means.
Q4: The [Alliance System] has very few quests and events. Will you consider adding more related activities?
A4: We would like Alliance to hold a greater role in the game, promoting a sense of community and belonging among players. Since the official Global Launch, the cap on Alliance members will be increased from the original 30 up to 50, and a new Alliance PVP mode will be added. The structure of Temporal Vortex will be revamped and corresponding Alliance rankings will be introduced. The challenge mode difficulty selection will also be optimized, allowing players to have more freedom in choosing their preferred difficulty.

[PVP]
Q1: Will PVP be available cross-server in future?
A1: We will enable cross-server PVP when appropriate, enriching the matchmaking experience for players. Availability is tied to a server's overall player progress, thereby avoiding excessive level disparities during cross-server matching.
Q2: Resources are limited in the early game! It's too difficult to [Simultaneously Train Multiple Lineups] for PVP!
A2: Of Dragonheir: Silent Gods' various PVP modes, Asynchronous PVP is a terrific strategy tester. But, one issue has given many players a headache — the high cost of hero training. It makes putting together more lineups difficult. This pitfall will be addressed in the Global Launch: The level of all a player's heroes will be synchronized to match the highest level hero they currently have. We believe that lower costs will help Adventurers develop more powerful combinations!
Q3: Will there be any [New PVP Mode] in the Global Launch?
A3: PVP in the Global Launch version will introduce a tag combat. Each player is required to assemble 3 lineups to compete. The strategy aspect will definitely be more thrilling!

[Other Updates]
As well as the above, we have made other changes and improvements that we would like to share with our Adventurers:
●Payments
When the Global Launch debuts, the Pass Feature will also go live. This feature allows Adventurers to obtain a lot of resources for free, as well as being able to pay to unlock more rare items. This ensures that every player will receive a regular flow of rewards!
●Servers
To welcome new players to Adenthia, we are further enhancing our servers, increasing player capacity in each (from 10,000 to 50,000).
●Art & Graphics
Compared to Close Beta Test 2, the art in the Global Launch will be heavily iterated. Maps, monsters, loading pages, skills and summoning effects will all be optimized further, whilst 4K resolution will be supported for PC.

[Season Reset, Off-Season and Server Merge]
Seasons in Adenthia run on 12–14-week cycles. At the end of a Season, Adventurers are rewarded according to their performance that Season, and after a brief pause, progress into a new Season.
In accordance with Season reset guidance in-game, player data from S0 will be fully retained, partly retained or completely cleared during S1 depending on the classification, as per the following:
●Fully Retained Content
① All Avatars and Avatar Frames obtained by the player.
② Wyrmarrow, Dragon Crystals, Summon Dice, Skill Scrolls and unexpired Monthly Cards.
③ Pure Sandcores, all of which can be exchanged for appropriate rewards in the Season Shop.
*Note: At the start of a new Season, Echo of Clepsydra acquired in the previous Season will be automatically converted to Pure Sandcores at a ratio of 100:1.
●Partly Retained Content
① Heroes, Skill Levels, and Inspiration Levels will be retained, but the Hero Level will be reset to Lv.1.
② Artifacts will be retained, but the Artifact Level will be reset to Lv.1.
③ A certain percentage of Essence of Creation obtained through Hero Summoning will be retained (consumed or not). Additionally, players will be rewarded with extra Essence of Creation in the new Season according to their in-game progress.
④ Unlocked Arcane Spells and Attribute Points acquired by the Player Character will be retained and can be reallocated at the start of a new Season.
●Fully Cleared Content
① Elemental Affinity Levels will be completely reset, in tandem with the rotation of Elemental Affinity rules in the new Season.
② Mist will regenerate on the Map, requiring players to re-explore the world to unlock the various teleport sites.
●About This Off-Season
The game is currently in the final stages of Global Launch (September 19th) preparation. After S0 ends (August 22nd), we will have a relatively long Off-Season to ensure that all players, new and old, are synchronized for S1 progression during the Global Launch. No new content or events will be available during this period, but players can continue to play.
●About Server Merge
Since the official Global Launch, we will increase the player capacity of our new servers even further. Servers involved in S0 will be unified in a merge. Detailed merge rules will be announced later, so please stay patient and wait for the latest news!

Thank you all for showing Dragonheir: Silent Gods your interest and support! Our game will release its Global Launch on September 19th, at which time it will be available on multiple platforms, including mobile and PC, with cross-platform data exchange, and support for 13 languages.
We look forward to meeting you in Adenthia and writing a brand-new chapter in your saga!

notes.title: Dragonheir Silent Gods Beginner's Guide
notes.content:
Beginner's Guide - How to quickly progress through the early stages
Hello, Travelers!
Before you start your journey in Dragonheir:  Silent Gods, do check out the early game guides we prepared for beginners. It will help you get familiar with the game faster, get a solid start early on, and also help you avoid some problems and surprises.
Create your character to start an adventure full of unknowns
As an Traveler, you woke up from the  without having a clue about the battle in the opening with the three-headed dragon god. To get back your memories and solve the mystery, you decided to gather companions and embark on an adventure full of unknowns. Dragonheir:  Silent Gods is a classic RPG with traditional settings. At the beginning and end of the prologue, you need to choose your race, appearance, origin and attributes, and get the corresponding check advantages for the various events you encounter on Adenthia.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/8b53507cae971ff2501447a5c535eecad6f7da88.png
Prioritize the Main Quest and level up your Journey Level
Follow the Dragonheir:  Silent Gods Main Quest to unlock new areas. Discover side quests and sandbox exploration content for the area in the meanwhile. This way, you can quickly get familiar with the game and also unlock more core features and gameplay.
The Main Quest will provide you with a large amount of travel experience, which can help you increase your Journey Level quickly. A higher Journey Level means more progress and a higher hero growth cap. Also, don't overlook the Daily Commission. Helping people in trouble on Adenthia can also provide you with a great deal of journey experience.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/609dab0fd8f39ded0f0eb0863674bf2d3881b9ed.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/81001a463e7d809c6f4b5acd326d6ba1c3ee8b02.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/469dc149336dd2f3ffc30a03f1f56d58f97ac120.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/38dbf2f7c9c3a69d1b5c35664d16cb13bdefcced.png
Ready to explore everything on your journey
Adenthia is full of surprises. Exploring hidden corners, solving ancient puzzles, gathering things and cooking, and completing commissions all offer rewards that will help you get further along in the Main Quest. Chaotic Temporal Sands will also reward those who love to explore. If you can earn a place in the leaderboard, you will be rewarded with a large amount of Dragon Crystals.
During your early exploration, it's recommended that you talk to as many NPCs as possible so that you can learn more about the continent, reveal hidden side quests, and even steal rare items. Don't forget to purchase a map from the Crimson Crow guide, which will be very helpful in your exploration.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/c99eaf12973307e0ca24f8a2c0aa2ce7db0334f4.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/014ec679c62ec0475698a9a17e6a66bd04ff63d7.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/ea91cbec317588edcd14d8f7b98d5ef3677b9c3a.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/1385e0e410cf67f1e93aeb46b4011fb2a5a7661b.png
Check Journals to view your current progress
While you may be confused by the amount of content on Adenthia, journals will be a great help. Completing the quests in the [Adventures] tab will help you quickly learn all about hero growth and dungeons, and gain great rewards and journey experience, while the [Guide] tab lists your current to-do list, so remember to keep an eye on them!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/52e27f20a47ebbd8149eedd948d4b9009c50c2ec.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/721d782fa2b7b815df7ea3e348d8d182a7e9c84b.png
Consume your Stamina in time
Adenthia is dotted with dungeons where you can consume Stamina to take on challenges and win EXP Potions, Elemental Crystals or equipment, all of which can greatly enhance your team. Your Stamina will recover over time, but anything over the cap will be wasted, so remember to convert your stamina into valuable resources in time.
Dragonheir:  Silent Gods has many planes. Players in pursuit of excellence can buy extra Stamina Bread to get ahead of other Plane Travelers!
Build your team according to hero attributes
In Dragonheir:  Silent Gods, each hero has unique skills and attributes. By building a team according to the heroes' attributes, you can make the most of their abilities.
[Element System]
The heroes have six different element types: Necrosis, Radiance, Lightning, Poison, Fire and Ice. Each season, these six elements will be matched in pairs, and the two paired elements can trigger Elemental Affinity. When a certain number of heroes are added to the team according to their element types, they can enjoy the Elemental Affinity bonus and gain an attribute buff.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/f768cdbe944b59341d9167b2af99300036706cb0.png
[Hero Positioning]
Hero positioning is divided into defense, support, and damage dealer, while the damage dealer is further divided into the following types: Frost, Dauntless, Rally, Wild, Summon and Poisoned. Each type has a different method for damage output, different types of heroes placed in the same team cannot cooperate; while the same type of heroes can complement each other to achieve a higher damage output. Enter the game to view the damage output methods for each type and build a reasonable output structure.
Place your defense heroes in the front row and let them resist enemy damage.  Don't make any move without a healing hero. Some of the support heroes can heal other heroes to ensure that your team remains intact after a fierce battle.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/e43453c8118a364e198f2eaa0faff88c60cf01da.png
Cultivate your hero skillfully
When cultivating your heroes, remember to place the highest priority on leveling up. It will provide the most cost-effective boost to your hero's attributes and help you win those battles you haven't won yet. Get EXP Potions in the Goblin Lair Dungeon and use it to power up your hero. Get Elemental Crystals in the Elemental Domain to break through the level cap.
You don't have to be overly concerned about the quality of the equipment in the early stages. Just pick and choose from the equipment you have. As your hero levels up and equipment dungeons open, you should start focusing on the equipment, choosing the Primary Attribute of the breastplate and gauntlets for your hero based on their positioning. (Defense heroes need Defense or HP, support heroes may need Accuracy, and damage dealers will definitely need Attack!) Equip your heroes with the full set of equipment whenever possible to get extra bonuses for their attributes. Equipment enhancements provide a big upgrade but are also expensive, so be selective and invest in the equipment that has the attributes you need to make them the best boost for your hero! You can get equipment and runes in Catacomb Dungeons and Ruins Dungeons.
Whenever your hero gets an upgrade, remember to try to challenge dungeons of higher difficulty. Each difficulty increase in the dungeon will provide you with better rewards and help your hero get a further boost. Through this virtuous cycle, you will eventually be able to defeat all the enemies on Adenthia.
Cultivate your hero with a sense of direction
In Dragonheir:  Silent Gods, each hero has unique features that can be used to their advantage in the right places. As the game progresses, you may have acquired a certain number of heroes in various ways, and struggle to decide on which one to cultivate first, second, and so on. Here're some advice.
In the early stages, prioritize boosting heroes with the same elemental affinity. It gives heroes a large bonus to their attributes and helps you win battles more easily. However, as battles become more difficult, you will need heroes that offer unique mechanics against enemies that may not be on your original lineup, so consider dropping elemental affinities and adding these key heroes to your team.
We also recommend that you prioritize your resources early on with regard to heroes with a larger attack range. These heroes work better in the Main Quest and Goblin Lair battles, which will help you get through the beginner's phase easily. As more gameplay unfolds, heroes who are better at attacking individual enemies will have a place to shine.
Of course, you can also cultivate heroes according to your own preferences, since every hero in Dragonheir:  Silent Gods is very powerful!
Cultivate your heroes with tactics
In Dragonheir:  Silent Gods, you will face numerous battles that vary in nature, some of which place certain restrictions on the heroes you can deploy. For example, in elemental dungeons, as the difficulty rises, monsters gain resistance to certain attributes, and you need to strategically switch your deployed heroes to reduce the difficulty of the battle. As mentioned earlier, in Dragonheir:  Silent Gods, each hero has a place to shine. Try cultivating and replacing your deployed heroes whenever you encounter a difficult battle.
And don't worry that you may have committed your resources to the wrong heroes. We'll be offering a reshaping event in the first few days of the season where you can try out different heroes and find the ones you like the best!
Travelers may be the last piece of the puzzle
Travelers have unique in-game traits. They can switch elemental types, and the Traverlers under each elemental type have different skill effects. Consider changing the Traveler's element type when you are having trouble challenging a stage!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/fdc98d915968760a46c4ae892dddf5bf9387dfc1.png
Learn the enemy's strategy in advance and counteract it
Check the enemy's information before the battle starts, adjust the heroes' positions so that they can do their jobs, and develop countermeasures against the enemy's skills to achieve victory. Spread out to prevent your ally from being targeted by AoE skills, and put other heroes in the back row to let the enemy focus on the front row defense heroes.
After entering the battle, keep an eye on the enemy's skill release sequence and unleash the ultimate skill to counterattack.
Cultivate your hero, use the right strategy, and you will surely win!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/4b6c4a70c8ea77d77bb4a8852685498c463ce4e5.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/1b5056e81931f9864bd18297ec356197d177de6d.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/2e4222e311ea3e73bdf25fe2398e1fa2a3220061.png
Failure is a step towards success
Don't be discouraged if you fail. In Dragonheir:  Silent Gods, if you fail and quit, you will be refunded the resources you spent at the beginning of the challenge. You will incur no real loss. You can use defeat statistics to strengthen your team, switch to heroes better suited to dealing with your current enemies, or ask other Travelers for help.
 
So, those are some of the key points to keep in mind when you start playing Dragonheir: Silent Gods. I believe these tips will come in handy when you set foot on Adenthia.

notes.title: DragonHeir Gameplay & Event Introduction
notes.content:
As the game progresses, you can acquire various materials and resources. In addition, you can get numerous rewards by participating in events held regularly in the game.
You can get a large number of Heliolite Dice, Wyrmarrow, Master Scroll, and other rewards.
Total Rewards: Get 150 Advanced Hero Summoning chances, valued at $750. In addition, get $200 worth of scrolls of various kinds for raising heroes as well as numerous training resources to help develop your own lineup.

 Follow the Main Quest

notes.title: DragonHeir - CBT2 Update Content Overview
notes.content:
〓Major Update〓

1. Season 
Added a Season framework and introduced reset rules to the sandbox and multiple systems. Settlement will be conducted on a seasonal basis, while the Season Shop will be opened. For more details about Season, please stay tuned to following announcements in our official communities.

2. Hero
1. Expanded the number of Heroes to over 110, including 15 newly added Legendary Heroes and 10 new Epic Heroes.
2. Optimized Hero display interface. Labels of Hero Base have been added in order to provide players with guidance on the development direction before they start.
3. Optimized the visual effects and skill animations of existing Heroes, enhanced details of their appearance.
4. Added an upgrade system for Elemental Affinity. Players may further their adventure and explore Adenthia to obtain upgrade materials, and then upgrade Elemental Affinity in "Psychicore".
5. Added Hero Biography feature. Achieve specified conditions to unlock Hero Biography and delve into each Hero's unique experiences.
6. Added an optional Player Character image of Half-Elf origin.

3. Dungeon and Stage
1. Adjusted the design of dungeons for Improvement and Equipment materials. Bosses' appearance and skills are now revamped anew, while difficulty and fun have been well balanced.
2. Adjusted the design of EXP dungeon. The former Lost Fortress has been updated to Goblin Lair. Difficulty and fun have now been well balanced.
3. Optimized the gameplay of Infinite Labyrinth, iterated its stage structure, and greatly enhanced its play experience and interface interaction.
4. Added a new mode — Pillar of Trial. Each Pillar of Trial can only be challenged by deploying Heroes of a specified Element. Clear Pillar of Trial to obtain handsome rewards.
5. Added a multiplayer co-op stage on the sandbox map — Outer Chaos Rift. Call on your friends, crusade in collaboration, and relish the distinctive delight of combat strategy in a multiplayer dungeon.
6. Added Tutorial Stages. Players can complete a series of challenges using designated Heroes to familiarize themselves with pre-battle deployment, Hero selection, monster skills and other battle-related techniques.
7. Added an option to challenge NPCs. Certain NPCs can be challenged and will yield handsome rewards when you defeat them.
8. Added new scene components and monsters, rendering battles more delightful on the aspect of strategy.


〓Other New Content〓
1. Added Alliance system. Alliance members may collaborate with each other in completing Alliance Commissions, and claiming generous rewards in the Sparkle Tournament held every two weeks by the Three Ears Brotherhood.
2. Added a simultaneous PVP mode — Champion Arena. It is open during a specific period each day, and rewards will be settled weekly based on Rank.
3. Added new Equipment items and Artifacts, adjusted the Set Attributes and Artifact Skills of certain existing items.
4. Added Drilling Ground at Camp. Players can freely build Hero combinations in simulation battles to test their performance in battles, or invite their friends into a friendly sparring.
5. Added new Side Quests to Nytheria and South Adenthia, adjusted and optimized certain Main Quests.
6. Added a Share feature. Fulfill specified conditions to unlock this feature and share memorable pictures or videos to Facebook or TikTok.
7. Added a multilingual chat channel. On this channel, players can share information on their Equipment and Heroes with each other and thus exchange strategies of their own builds or simply show off their franchise Heroes!
8. Added an event preview feature, allowing players to take a glimpse of all important events in the current Season in advance.
9. Added 6 in-game languages: German, French, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese.


〓Optimization and Adjustment〓
1. Adjusted Journey Level and the EXP required for upgrade. The current maximum Journey Level has been adjusted to Lv.50.
2. Optimized certain UI interaction designs, conforming to the overall style so as to enhance player experience.
3. Adjusted the beginner chapter and the one after character customization, deeply optimized the pace of the early game.
4. Optimized the visuals of battle, fixed the model overlap between giant Bosses and other objects, and adjusted the display logic of Ultimate Skill animations.
5. Optimized the reverb effects of certain indoor scenes and the sound effects of certain interfaces.
6. Optimized the visuals of certain scenes.
7. Adjusted the categories, names, introductions and quick acquisition of certain items.
8. Optimized the form of interaction and quest logic of certain events.

notes.title: CBT2 - Update Preview - Letter from the Development Team
notes.content:
Greetings, Travelers! We're delighted to be welcoming you back again! We cordially invite you to be the first to experience our game once again!

We shared an unforgettable adventure together in Adenthia just four months ago. The heroic deeds of our Travelers have spread far and wide throughout Adenthia's denizens, and the development team alike! With this latest version, many of your suggestions and criticisms have been taken on board and we've made changes and improvements. Thanks to your help, we are making a better world, so once more we extend to you our heartfelt thanks!

Over these past four months, the development team has been blazing away, aiming to make Dragonheir even more unique, and Adenthia has changed dramatically along with it. We're aware these might be disruptive, so we wanted to share these changes and adjustments with you ahead of time.

1. Heroes and Combat
We've added 50 brand new heroes, but not all of them will feature in CBT2 for now. As of CBT2, we have over 110 heroes, hopefully offering our Travelers even greater freedom of choice. For the time being, our CBT2 version hero bases include: Summon, Dauntless, Rally, Wild, Poison, and Frost. "Burn" and "Electric Shock" heroes will be gradually introduced in later Seasons, so you'll not find them in CBT2.
Adjustment rationale: Previously, Fire element had two bases ("Wild" and "Burn") and Lightning element as well ("Dauntless" and "Electric Shock"). Because heroes of the same element could possess two different bases, assembling teams of heroes sharing the same bases proved difficult. Thus, to make obtaining heroes with bases that synergize well together more convenient for everyone, we have condensed down the hero pool for Fire and Lightning heroes. But don't fret! The heroes cut for now will return in OBT or later Seasons.
We have also buffed some rare and epic heroes, and there are also heroes with versatile bases capable of both supporting and defensive roles. Travelers should have no trouble building a complete combat-ready team able to handle most situations!

In CBT2 Adenthia, Elemental Affinity changes radically with the influence of plane rotation: Affinities between Ice and Poison, Fire and Radiance, Necrosis and Lightning are higher than ever before! Teaming up heroes of the paired elements will lead to welcome surprises on the battlefield.
Adjustment rationale: We're always striving to offer you fulfilling strategy options and a wide variety of builds. We're keen on offering you fresh experiences with each Beta, so CBT2 will feature brand new Elemental Affinity effects. Notably, the rules of Elemental Affinity will change with each new Season. It's our hope that the regular rotation of Elemental Affinities will create a richer experience for everyone, as well as justify the value of each hero.

Every hero's design has been perfected, adding their population, class, and alignment, providing them with full background stories. Should they become companions, they'll engage in chatter with you at Camp and in the sandbox, with some heroes expressing their thoughts on the journey so far (thanks to the players who made this recommendation in the last Beta).
Adjustment rationale: We want the hero companions that players engage to be genuine, living denizens of Adenthia, each with their own unique histories. To give Travelers a better grasp of companions' stories and to understand the customs of Adenthia through them, we've added the aforementioned content with the intention of offering a more immersive experience.

We've added a new hero attribute called "Enlightenment". It provides a new dimension to hero development by adding bonuses to non-critical damage and to some Healing/Shield effects.
Adjustment rationale: This is aimed for achieving the pursuit of hero attributes a more fruitful one, whilst also offering players varied attributes on different heroes. No more bland focus on Attack and Crit! By adding "Enlightenment", we hope to offer players new focus on hero development and a more fruitful, rewarding development experience overall.

2. Dungeons and gameplay
We've revamped and iterated the EXP Dungeon, something that will significantly improve Travelers' battles against Goblins! After CBT2 concludes, the EXP Dungeon won't be a Tower Defense anymore, instead being a Horde mode featuring continuously refreshing waves of monsters.
Adjustment rationale: Tower Defense is classic, fun-filled gameplay, characterized by strong strategy and playability. However, considering that EXP Dungeons need to be farmed a great many times, Tower Defense gameplay would become incredibly tedious. Plus, the need for manual play and concentration would be a huge source of stress in the long term. For this reason, we've changed the EXP Dungeon gameplay into one that requires less manual effort and is easily automated.
That's not to say Tower Defense is vanishing! You'll find Tower Defense all over the place in every corner of the sandbox, in stronghold conflicts and all kinds of places Travelers won't expect! When facing these stages, adventurers must be prepared! Carefully and effectively deploy before battle, use precise actions and rational team composition to tackle every challenge.

We have updated and upgraded most of the Elemental Ascension Dungeons and Equipment Dungeons. Everything in the Dungeons, from the Boss appearance to the gameplay mechanics, has been comprehensively overhauled. We hope the upgraded audio-visual effects and gameplay mechanics will breathe new life into your Dungeons! Since Elemental Dungeons are equipped with mechanics that buff and resist one element, Travelers will need to be diligent! Ensure you develop diverse teams ready to handle stages of different elements.
Adjustment rationale: We want Dragonheir to offer a richly rewarding environment for trial and error that encourages Travelers to place emphasis on horizontal character development, focusing on the characteristics of hero skills, Elemental Affinities, and bases.
Changes to the Elemental Ascension Dungeons are intended to improve the current Dungeon experience. They'll also help prepare for richer gameplay and test environments to come in future!
Furthermore, adjustments to Equipment Dungeons and Rune Dungeons, as well as tweaks to Dungeon Boss skill mechanics, are in place to ensure all our Travelers understand: Each Dragonheir hero has their own unique value against different opponents. The fun of synergizing skills, Elemental Affinities and bases is what we truly aim to offer to all Travelers. Adventure and Strategy are Dragonheir's only tags. In the upcoming CBT2 Season, there is neither a sole answer to strength or weakness, nor will there be for each upcoming Season.
All of us on the development team have been extremely hands on, playing Dragonheir ourselves and testing whether our design is delivering the fun we expect it to. I'll take this chance to drop a sneaky hint! There are a few epic heroes (not legendary!) that are key to overcoming tough nuts like the Blood Prince and Deadly Harpy! As for who, you can find out for yourself, and tell us all about it, in CBT2!

3. Rewards & Seasons
We've added our new Season gameplay to CBT2, the rules for which will be posted separately in official communities.
Compared with CBT1's 30-day duration, this Season will last approximately three months. Accordingly, the pace of in-game reward distribution will also be drastically altered:
The probability of summoning legendary heroes with Heliolite Dice (Advanced Hero Summoning item) will be increased to 3%. Additionally, a legendary hero will be guaranteed in 35 draws. As a result, Heliolite Dice will become more valuable, and thus much rarer.
Heliolite Dice offered by Main Quests and the Book of Adventure will be markedly reduced. Only a small quantity will be available from Main Quests. However, Travelers can obtain a wealth of Wyrmarrow from various quests and dailies! Wyrmarrow can be used to purchase Heliolite Dice in the Shop.
Once the Season concludes, you will receive a veritable bounty of rewards in accordance with your performance. All those goodies will make next Season even more enjoyable!
The quantity of Starlight Dice (Basic Hero Summoning item) available has been significantly increased. Through using Starlight Dice to summon many epic heroes, Travelers will be well-positioned to handle most Dungeons.
We have removed the Day-7 and Day-14 legendary hero login rewards. Instead, Travelers will now receive epic heroes on Day 3.
To ensure a better experience for our CBT2 players, we will issue these website pre-registration rewards in advance: Gold, Dice, legendary heroes, etc. can be obtained by fulfilling certain criteria.
Adjustment rationale:
CBT2 is a Season beta whose data will not be erased. All heroes acquired will be permanently retained. Compared to the CBT1 impermanent test, we've cut down on the rewards a little to ensure greater longevity and enjoyment of the game.
Of course, we hope that players will take full advantage of the longer three-month test duration to really sink your teeth into the build experience! We don't want login rewards to influence players' choices (during the CBT1 test, almost all players mainly developed the rewarded legendary heroes). Rather, we want players to enjoy varied, creative team composition strategies.
In replacing many rewards with the common Wyrmarrow currency, we hope to give Travelers more freedom of choice — They can choose whether to use them to purchase Skill Scrolls and enhance existing heroes or exchange them for summoning items to acquire more heroes.
We've significantly increased the quantity of Starlight Dice. With this, we hope you'll acquire more epic heroes and strive for more complete, versatile elemental builds and team compositions to provide an engaging, fruitful experience. (When compared to CBT1, in which many teams were heavily dependent on legendary heroes, making the experience threshold too high).

In addition to the aforementioned content, we've added a host of other features:
We have reset and optimized the game's opening chapters: The overall Chaos Universum experience and the staging of subsequent chapters: The storyline and gameplay in the Forest and Plains regions have been totally overhauled.
We've also added plenty of new gameplay features: Added 2 NPC-related systems (Challenge and Relationship), new team PVE mode (two Travelers fight alongside each other), new time-limited real-time PVP mode, friendly sparring, Alliance, Alliance war, Seasons, and more! Stay tuned to community news for more details!
Travelers, we look forward to joining you in Adenthia once again for CBT2!

notes.title: Preview of New Features: Enjoy the Multiverse Through Passing "Seasons"!
notes.content:
The rallying horns of Adenthia are sounding, the DragonHeir CBT2 is about to begin!
Since CBT1 ended, we've developed lots of new content! We'd like to now introduce you to one of this update's biggest highlights: Seasons!

Question 1: What are Seasons?
Answer 1: Much like when you're running around adventuring, we want to keep your experiences in the "Campaign" of Adenthia fresh and varied, including ever-changing plots and environments. Seasons are episodic experiences, each one offering players something complete and fresh.

A Season will initially run for 12-14 weeks. Other Seasons will see inclusions of the following:
- New narrative content: New maps, new stories, new bosses, and all-new heroes and new populations!
- New collaborations: We'll gradually be introducing licensed DND crossovers with Drizzt, Elminster and other heroes who are visiting Adenthia.
- Combat companions: Players from other planes can join your adventure of the new Season and aid you in your crusade against an ancient boss or compete for glory in the arena!
- Reroll: A herculean strongman with all points in Strength can become a wizened Scholar with significant Intelligence!
- Elemental Affinity Rotation: Affinities among elements change between Seasons. For example, in S0, Ice and Poison may have an affinity, but come S1, Ice might instead have an affinity with Necrosis. It will impact combat strategy dramatically!
- Resetting Game Resources: The reset is to ensure gameplay doesn't become stale. Once a Season is closed and totaled up, everyone will receive a boatload of goodies! (That includes limited and exclusive rewards). See Question 2 for more information.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/14269b151bbd406a64aa5b8099f49fbd7f6ccffe.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/bc7cff8d1d64947015f983a2bb279b878e2aa905.jpg

Question 2: Which resources will be reset each Season?
Answer 2: We've actually been discussing this for a long while. At the core of "Reset" is the desire to prevent players getting bored, giving them the fun of rerolling, and trying out new strategies so the late game doesn't become tedious.

Reset rules of S0 are as follows:

Permanently Saved
High-value resources purchased or acquired by players, including Heroes, Artifacts, and Skill Scrolls, will not be reset.
Seasonally Reset
Stamina acquired in the current Season and resources transmuted from Stamina, such as Hero Upgrade Materials, Improvement Materials and Equipment, will all be reset.

Of course, whilst equipment will be reset, there will be new dungeons to undertake and strategies to employ for each new Season, ensuring acquiring those materials and equipment won't be as troublesome as in some other similar games. (I'm sure we're all fed up of farming instances over and over only to end up with worthless equipment drops!)
If you're curious, more detailed reset rules will be found in-game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/509d0bc3ab9f776595e6f6a85af3f746f6d19e0c.png

Question 3: Why do Seasons? That seems like a risky decision.
Answer 3: It certainly is risky! But having spent thousands of hours with Team RPGs, the development team picked out a few issues:
- Alongside raising stats over a lengthy period, players wanted to try different team builds, but found it wasn't affordable. Challenging stages became increasingly difficult, and they found themselves expending waaaaaaaaay too much effort to complete a stage.
- The longer the game is live, the greater the chasm between the old players and new players becomes, and so ever fewer players can stay and play together.
- The dungeons and bosses never change, the teams barely change, and players end up farming for equipment, an experience which is grindy and tedious.
So, that's why we aimed to solve this problem by making the bold but difficult decision to implement Seasons.
- New Seasons mean all-new content, brand new goals, and fun gameplay.
- Resetting stat values lowers leveling costs and lets players try out a wider range of team builds. Plus, for players who need time away from the game, coming back after a break isn't the end of the world! When a new Season begins, everyone is back in the same starting position.
- Season Settlement is a nice justification to shower players with rewards from time to time!
But equally, we recognize that Season is a brand-new design, so we are expecting plenty of problems and bugs. That's why we need to run this Pilot Season (S0) to perfect it.

Question 4: CBT2 is the Pilot Season, S0. How will the pilot differ from the official ones?
Answer 4: CBT2 (S0) is essentially a preview version of the official Season (S1). Nothing will be deleted, you can make purchases and enjoy a taste of S1 content in advance.
The primary aim is to verify Season gameplay on a small scale. Therefore, S0 will only be open for a limited time (limited access as well) and only in some countries/regions.
S0 will have the same settlement process as the official Season. Rewards obtained in S0, including heroes and artifacts, will also be kept until the official Season is released. S0 testers will also be rewarded with exclusive commemorative rewards!
As for what's to come in S1, we're going to leave you hanging and build the suspense!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/6ab152e0e8f8842ab0ce05b6ddfb223a664224c8.jpg
Note: Season rules will be changed and adjusted in accordance with test feedback.

notes.title: Dragonheir: Silent Gods - CBT Creator Fest
notes.content:
Great day, Travelers! @everyone @🌟・Game Partner  

Today, we are happy to announce the start of a new video creator fest for the current closed beta test (CBT) of Dragonheir: Silent Gods!  

Do you have ideas for a video about the game Dragonheir: Silent Gods?  

Now is your chance to show your creativity by making a short video about the game! 

Eight of the videos submitted will be chosen, with three winners pulled and selected by the most views! The five honorable mentions with the best video quality and creative ideas will also receive a prize!  The Top 50 players who participate in the event early can win an exclusive in-game gift code!  

Here is the list of prizes: 
- Top 3 Views - $100 Amazon Gift Card for each winner. The video will be uploaded and displayed on our social media outlets! 
- Top 5 honorable mentions - $30 Amazon Gift Card for each user chosen 
- Top 50 "early birds" - in-game gift codes for each. The earlier you participate, the more likely you will win more in-game rewards.

How to participate? Please click this link to join our Discord group to learn more details!!!
